page.overview:
Who is Capvincible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Capvincible is an evil variant of the main Invincible and a supporting antagonist in third season of the series.

Capvincible was one of the variants of Invincible who would be assembled by Angstrom Levy to start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension.

Capvincible has nearly identical physique to his original counterpart. He is tall and fair-skinned. Unlike other variants, his hair is completely covered by his outfit, so it’s unknown whether he has hair or is bald. It is also assumed he has brown eyes.
